edges.label: observed_under
edges.note: work key travels around the packet, never in it

edges.label: fans_out_to
edges.note: only when status is blocked or done; best-effort, failures reported; the watch relation lives in subscription.session

fluid.mode: nothing is required; every edge is available on operator intent alone
fluid.guarantee: sessions run unattended by default; two sessions coordinate only because the operator puts them under one work ref — no coordinator started, no config, no permission, nothing waiting

interventions.act: spawn more lanes, retire lanes, re-scope the packet

lane.note: independent process; no manager between sender and lane

message.note: advisory only; claims presence, never completion; optional status (started|milestone|blocked|done) lets an activating agent aggregate progress without parsing prose

observation.note: presence declaration, never control; coordinates (worktree/repo/paths) are required but non-exclusive — overlap is normal and never refuses entry

session.note: harness-side thread/process identity; retained by sender

subscription.note: anyone may subscribe to any lane; persistent until unsubscribed

work.note: typed outcome string; the join key across all three systems

rules: no edge from observation or message into control state (no leases, assignment, lifecycle)
no secrets, transcripts, or machine-specific session ids inside handoff_packet
receipt is not an observation and message is not a receipt
work key travels around the packet, never in it
coordinates are required on observation but confer no exclusivity — overlap never refuses entry
blocked and done fan out to subscribers best-effort; a failed delivery is reported, never fatal, and nothing waits
